questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Consider the following dioxide of group 14
$1.C{O}_{2}$
$2.Si{O}_{2}$
$3.Ge{O}_{2}$
$4.Sn{O}_{2}$
$5.Pb{O}_{2}$
The basicity of the dioxide alters in the order
questions.solution:
The basicity of the dioxide alters in the order
$C{O}_{2} < Si{O}_{2} < Ge{O}_{2} < Sn{O}_{2} < Pb{O}_{2}$
The basicity increases on moving down the group. Thus, $C{O}_{2}$ and $Si{O}_{2}$ are purely acidic. $Ge{O}_{2}$ is not as strongly acidic as $Si{O}_{2}$. It is weakly acidic and weakly basic. $Sn{O}_{2}$ and $Pb{O}_{2}$ are definitely amphoteric.

D. the reluctance of silicon to form $p\pi - p\pi$ bonds to itself is clearly shown by the fact that silicon does not exists in graphite-like structure, but only in diamond like structure.
